title: Identification of growth years for Puerariae Thomsonii Radix based on hyperspectral imaging technology and deep learning algorithm
summary: CNN and VGG16 classify hyperspectral images by Puerariae Thomsonii Radix growth year; the paper reports held-out testing, including outer-surface 1-year-versus-other F1 scores of 93.51% and 92.90%, supporting a narrow medicinal-material quality-control result. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
